truth.description: isReferenced now answers no for the target of a for...of loop, and isReferencedIdentifier passes that answer on for a ForOfStatement parent, so the reactivity transform walk in reactivityTransform.ts no longer rewrites a $ref binding it holds when that binding is a bare loop target, and let last = $ref(null) followed by for (last of items) {} compiles to a loop that overwrites the ref variable instead of setting last.value.

distractions.why: walkIdentifiers always passes its own knownIds to walkForOfStatement, so the fresh default map is never used and every loop variable lands in the caller's scope count.
